name: Public web digest
description: A resumable artifact graph using the official Hacker News API. The demo makes no claims about article bodies.

nodes.title: Digest brief
nodes.acceptance: The brief defines the public metadata-only digest, item limit, source provenance and verification limits.

nodes.title: Public API snapshot
nodes.acceptance: Retain the source URL, retrieval time, selected IDs, returned item metadata and live/fixture mode.

recipe.instructions: Fetch topstories and selected story metadata from the official public API. Use bounded timeouts and retain a stable snapshot.

nodes.title: Score-based selection
nodes.acceptance: The ranking uses the snapshot's scores with a deterministic ID tie-breaker.

recipe.instructions: Rank the saved story metadata; do not refetch it.

nodes.title: Source coverage
nodes.acceptance: Count source hosts and returned stories from the same snapshot. Do not probe live URL availability.

recipe.instructions: Calculate source coverage independently from ranking.

nodes.title: Linked digest
nodes.acceptance: Every included item links to its original URL and discussion; describe only the metadata actually retrieved.

recipe.instructions: Combine ranking and coverage into a concise Markdown digest with source and retrieval details.

nodes.title: Digest contract checks
nodes.acceptance: The real verification command succeeds: displayed titles/scores, ordered IDs, item links, provenance and coverage match the snapshot. Link presence is not a live link or factual article audit.

recipe.instructions: Run verify.mjs against the artifacts and retain actual exit code, stdout and stderr.

nodes.title: Usable result
nodes.acceptance: Link the digest, source snapshot and real verification output, and state the verification limits.

recipe.instructions: Deliver links to the actual artifacts and read the result against goal.md.
